description: The Carbon Monitor research team publishes CarbonMonitor-Power to describe electricity generation across 37 countries. The own deposit begins in January 2016 and separates coal, gas, oil, nuclear, solar, wind, hydro and other renewable generation. It provides combined, daily and hourly CSV files, freely accessible on Figshare under CC BY 4.0. Country aggregates can calibrate generation-mix and seasonal-operation assumptions in simulations such as model-pypsa, including comparisons around holidays and major disruptions. A caveat is that the deposit describes frequent updates but does not state the final observation date for the inspected version. Its 37-country coverage is broad, not universal, and national generation totals do not provide plant-level dispatch or network constraints. Hourly and daily products also should not be treated as having identical temporal detail. No generation values were downloaded or checked for completeness.
